{{Quote|Chancellor Palpatine, in light of this unprovoked attack on Coruscant and the vulnerabilities it raises, I propose the Republic purchase an additional 5 million clone troopers.|Senator Halle Burtoni|<ref name="Pursuit" />}}
During the [[The galaxy/Legends|pan-galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the Republic was presented with a bill by Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] that called for an '''increase in military production'''. The bill was drafted in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], when, after almost a year of open warfare, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was facing serious issues of [[Troop/Legends|troop]] depletion and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] was steadily gaining ground. Around that time, the Senate began to debate the necessity of troop surges that could supplement the already-deployed [[Republic Military/Legends|armed forces]] and the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] in the field. Although the advocates for military enhancement gained considerable traction early in the discussion, uncertainty over the Republic's fiscal integrity generated concern among many senators who felt that the price of troop production would be prohibitively costly. In response, Senator [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]] of [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]] introduced a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|bill]] that called for the deregulation of the banking industry so that the Republic might secure lines of credit to fund future troop surges. After a devastating [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|Confederate terror attack]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the deregulation measure was passed and a budding [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace initiative]] was shot down.

These two developments allowed for Burtoni to introduce her legislation, which specifically called for the [[Cloning/Legends|creation]] and training of five million new [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from her constituent [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. To fund the [[Army/Legends|army]] expansion, the bill took advantage of Senator Saam's successful legislation by opening a new loan through the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]&mdash;[[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] premier financial institution. Although Burtoni's proposal was widely supported by her colleagues, several senators, including [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], opposed it on grounds both fiscal and pacifistic. Their opposition became even more impassioned when they learned that the InterGalactic Banking Clan's loan would carry with it a twenty-five percent interest rate, repayment of which would easily bankrupt the Republic and cease all public service spending.

Organa and Amidala lobbied their fellow representatives for support, but found little. To ensure their failure, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] and [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]] to threaten and batter Republic senators who might vote against Burtoni's measure. Although the tactic was widely successful, many in the Senate respected the opinion of Senator Organa, and so the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] planned to make a final address to the congress before the final vote commenced. However, on the day of the vote, Organa was severely injured in an [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt, forcing Amidala to make the speech in his place. The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] senator's plea was well-received, as it focused heavily on the tangible cost the bill would have on families within the Republic. Despite this, the bill was approved, prompting Amidala and her coalition to quickly draft a piece of [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|counter-legislation]] that would nullify Burtoni's success.

==Description==
{{Dialogue|Organa|The Republic is already operating in deep debt. How do you propose we pay for these additional troops?|Burtoni|My people are drafting an emergency appropriations bill that would raise funds&mdash;|Amidala|From the Banking Clan?|Burtoni|Yes, of course. Do you have an alternate means of paying?|attr=Senators Organa, Burtoni, and Amidala discuss Burtoni's new bill|src=<ref name="Pursuit" />}}
The military enhancement bill was a piece of legislation introduced to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] with the primary purpose of expanding the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]&mdash;specifically, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Written by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] senatorial delegation, the legislation acted as both a major appropriations bill and an approval for a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] surge. It provided for the military expansion with the inclusion of two major provisions: first, an order for five million new [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to be grown and trained by the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. In order to pay for the drastic troop increase, the bill included a secondary provision: a request for a massive loan from the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. The loan would be used to compensate the Kaminoan government for the clones and would be paid off by the Republic with an interest rate of twenty-five percent, as arbitrated by the Banking Clan. Acquisition of the loan would drastically increase the size of the Republic's military spending budget, thereby drawing funds away from other Republic programs, like [[Water/Legends|water]] maintenance, power management, public education, and healthcare.<ref name="Pursuit" />

==History==
===Peace fails===
{{SeeAlso|Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends}}
{{Dialogue|Bar Gane|How dare they?!|Paulness|They attack, and now they want peace?!|Amidala|Chancellor Palpatine, may I remind the senators that the peace proposal was made ''prior'' to the assault?|Bar Gane|That only ''highlights'' its insincerity!|attr=Senators Bar Gane, Paulness, and Amidala argue after the bombing on Coruscant|src=<ref name="Pursuit" />}}
The military enhancement bill came after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] became engulfed in armed conflict between the massive clone [[Army/Legends|armies]] of the Galactic Republic and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|forces]] of the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The war, which affected the entire galaxy but was largely fought in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] far from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], took a heavy toll on the Republic in terms of both lives and finances, and polarized [[Politics/Legends|politics]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Animosity between the two belligerent states repeatedly reached fevered levels, with leaders of both the Republic and the Confederacy calling for the war to continue until their enemy was annihilated. These calls usually gained traction in the Galactic Senate of the Republic and the Confederacy's [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]], resulting in a continued escalation of violence and bloodshed.

In this charged atmosphere, war profiteers and titans of military industries had a prolific influence in the governmental dealings of the Republic and Confederacy. In secret meetings, representatives of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and InterGalactic Banking Clan maneuvered legislation and initiatives onto congressional agendas to ensure that their respective employers would continue to profit from the conflict with as little hinderance as possible. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], one such bill made its way to the Republic's [[Grand Convocation Chamber|senate floor]]. Proposed by [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]], the [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|bill]] overhauled the Republic's financial system, ostensibly to allow the government to better fund future expansions of the military. This line of argument attracted the Senate's many pro-war delegates, but the true purpose of the bill lied in its deregulatory provisions; the legislation removed many of the restrictions on banking institutions, allowing for conglomerates like the InterGalactic Banking clan to conduct business with little to no government oversight.

[[File:RepublicFinancialReformBill-POP.png|thumb|left|280px|The Senate's Grand Convocation Chamber descends into chaos after the bombing on Coruscant.]]
The prospect of complete autonomy for commercial interests and the escalation of violence and debt greatly concerned [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had dedicated her career to finding a peaceful end to the war. During the debates over Saam's bill, Amidala violated Senate [[Republic Senate non-communication law/Legends|standards]] by fleeing Coruscant and secretly meeting with [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] on the Separatist capital of [[Raxus Secundus|Raxus]]. Bonteri, who had represented [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in the Senate until she seceded with her world, was one of the few Confederate politicians who were eager to bring the war to a diplomatic conclusion. Together with Amidala, she drafted a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace initiative]] and brought it before the Separatist Parliament. Although she faced heavy opposition and was working against the will of Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], Bonteri was able to convince her colleagues to adopt the measure and sue for peace.

Dooku, who operated as both the Confederate leader and as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Tyranus, worked alongside his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], and his top [[General/Legends|general]], [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], to orchestrate an attack on Coruscant that would derail the peace proposal and force the financial reform bill through to approval. Carried out by disguised [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]], the [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|attack]] devastated the Coruscant [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|power grid]], causing [[Coruscant mandatory blackouts/Legends|rolling blackouts]] and explosions across the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]]. The blast was deemed an act of Separatist [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]], stoking resentment and distrust in the Senate. As a result, the financial reform bill was quickly approved by the legislature and ratified by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine&mdash;the alter ego of the Sith Master, Darth Sidious.

The morning after the bombing, the Senate convened once again to issue a formal reaction to the bombing and the Confederate peace offering. In light of the attack, many delegates wanted to reject the initiative outright and ridiculed Senator Amidala for her support of the proposal. The loudest proponent of continued warfare was Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], who quickly introduced the military enhancement bill. Drafted by her staff, the bill authorized a massive expansion of the Grand Army of the Republic by drawing funds from an InterGalactic Banking Clan loan, which was now possible due to the passage of the financial reform bill. Although Amidala and her colleague, Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], were quick to object, public sentiment had turned against their calls for peace. When the Naboo politician tried once more to convince the Senate of the legitimacy of the Confederate peace accord, she was openly accused of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] by [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara's]] Senator [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Senator [[Dantum Roohd/Legends|Dantum Roohd]]. The argument became moot when Chancellor Palpatine received a message from Count Dooku, in which he accused the Republic of orchestrating the [[Attack on Confederate people/Legends|assassination]] of Senator Bonteri. Dooku withdrew the peace offering, allowing the Senate war hawks to write off the Confederate olive branch and begin anew their push for escalation.

===Fighting and funding===
{{Dialogue|Plain|We will lend the Republic at our standard interest rate of&hellip;twenty-five percent.|Amidala|What?!|Farr|Twenty-five percent? That's outright theft!|Amidala|Your previous arrangement with the Republic was ten percent!|Plain|Please, please! That was before deregulation. The same rules don't apply, my dear. The Separatists don't seem to mind a rate hike. In fact, they just secured a loan for an additional three million battle droids.|attr=Plain, Amidala, and Farr discuss the new lending arrangement|src=<ref name="Pursuit" />}}
Immediately after Burtoni introduced her bill, Amidala and Organa quickly formed a coalition with Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to oppose the measure. Although it would be a severe uphill battle, Organa, a well-respected senior member of congress, agreed to lead the effort to defeat the bill and recruit other legislators to the cause; meanwhile, Amidala and Farr researched the logistics and costs of the military expansion. The two of them arranged a meeting with Banking Clan representative [[Mak Plain/Legends|Mak Plain]] to discuss the terms of the loan proposed in Burtoni's bill. During their conversation in Plain's [[Mak Plain's office/Legends|office]], the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Banker/Legends|banker]] revealed to Amidala and Farr that the loan would carry with it an interest rate of twenty-five percent&mdash;a drastic increase from the Republic's previously arranged rate of ten percent. Although Farr asserted that the rate hike was tantamount to theft, Plain assured him that the increase was entirely legal and reasonable given the recent passage of the deregulatory measures in Senator Saam's financial reform bill. Amidala returned to Organa with this information and the two decided that their best chance for success in the upcoming debate was for the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] to address the full senate with an impassioned plea.

==Controversy==
===The drums of war===
{{Quote|Can't you all see this bill is short-sighted? Millions of clones won't win this war. The only winner will be the banking clan. They want to pass this bill so badly, they're using scare tactics to sway votes!''"<br />"''I am not intimidated, Senator.''"<br />"''Then why are you voting for additional troops?''"<br />"''I happen to believe more clones are precisely what we need. And my caucus agrees with me. I am sorry.|Amidala discusses the upcoming vote with Mot-Not Rab|<ref name="Pursuit" />}}
The Muun went on to reveal that the Confederacy had also recently applied for a loan to finance an additional three million [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], which would give the Separatist Droid Army enough firepower to easily defeat the Republic and overrun Coruscant.

===Intimidation and violence===
{{Dialogue|Tyranus|I see Senator Amidala hasn't given up her crusade.|Robonino|She doesn't have the votes, my lord.|Hyoki|Hah! We've taken care of twenty senators! Ha!|Tyranus|It may be time to send her a message as well.|Robonino|You want us to 'have a talk' with her?|Tyranus|No, I think something special is called for in Senator Amidala's case|Robonino|We're all ears boss.|Tyranus|Take her out of the game.|attr=Darth Tyranus discusses Senator Amidala with bounty hunters Robonino and Chata Hyoki|src=<ref name="Pursuit" />}}
In this heavily charged atmosphere, the few politicians who were interested in pursuing peaceful solutions to the war were often vilified and publicly lambasted for their views.

The bill's opponents initially needed to sway the minds of only a handfull of senators, but just as with the financial reform bill, the Sith Lords Darth Sidious and Darth Tyranus sought to ensure the passage of the military enhancement bill in order to ensure the continuation of the Clone Wars.
